ctx.x: Terry Gibbs was born Julius Gubenko on October 13, 1924 in New York City.

He has shared the bandstand and recording studio with a long list of major jazz artists including Buddy Rich, Benny Goodman and Mel Torme. Terry’s vibraphone, drumming and band leader skills have been a significant part of jazz in America for over sixty years.
Terry was interviewed in New York City on January 12, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
